queries.result: Official results identified the Concello de Vigo cadastral consultation service, the Dirección General del Catastro sede, the Vigo Catastro office, and Catastro INSPIRE parcel/WFS documentation. No anonymous Vigo parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.result: Official Vigo urban-planning documentation confirms the municipal viewer can search Catastro parcels by the first 14 cadastral-reference characters, while the Vigo municipal service says parcel information is obtained directly from the Oficina del Catastro. No public anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

registryBasis: The official Concello de Vigo cadastral-information procedure states that parcel plans and cadastral information are obtained directly from the Oficina del Catastro; the official Catastro directory identifies the Gerencia Territorial de Pontevedra, Oficina de Vigo, as the local office. This evidences the local service/custodian, not an open citywide parcel API.

requests.outcome: Official Vigo procedure fetched; confirms parcel plan/information lookup through the Catastro office. No feature schema or geometry response exposed in the public procedure page.
Official Catastro INSPIRE page fetched; publishes the cadastral-parcel WFS endpoint, INSPIRE WMS endpoint, and parcel dataset documentation.
Published parcel WFS capability request returned the service error page; no schema, CRS, or geometry response obtained. This is an endpoint/request failure, not evidence of cadastral absence.
Published parcel WFS capability request with explicit version also returned HTTP 400; no schema or geometry obtained.
Published INSPIRE WMS capability request returned HTTP 400; no layer schema, CRS, or map response obtained.
Legacy documented WMS connection reset before an HTTP response; no TLS bypass or retry through credentials was attempted.
Anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds; the published viewer manual was used as documentation, not as evidence of a successful parcel API response.
